indicator.name: NASDAQ-100 Constituents Above 200-day Average
indicator.description: The percentage of current NASDAQ-100 constituents trading above their own 200-day averages.
indicator.source_name: Yahoo Finance adjusted prices for current NASDAQ-100 constituents
indicator.methodology: For each trading day, the percentage of the current NASDAQ-100 constituent list whose adjusted close exceeds its own 200-trading-day simple moving average. The component is trend-oriented: higher breadth maps to a higher score through a historical percentile.
indicator.limitations: Current constituents are used for the whole history, so the series has survivorship bias. The list is bundled with the project (or read from NASDAQ_CONSTITUENTS_URL) and the index is reconstituted every December. History is limited to the configured lookback (six years by default).
